name: Gaspésie National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on two summer trails (La Lucarne, La Chute-Sainte-Anne), one campground and picnic areas, May to October.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on two summer trails (La Lucarne, La Chute-Sainte-Anne), one campground and picnic areas, May to October.

excerpts.quote: Prenez note que les chiens sont admis du début mai jusqu'à la fin octobre.

dogRules.text: Summer trails: La Lucarne and La Chute-Sainte-Anne.
Camping de la Rivière and Espace VR de la Vallée (summer only).
Picnic areas near Camping de la Rivière, La Boussole and La Grande-Fosse lookout.
No water access and no winter trails.
Pets are not allowed at Gîte du Mont-Albert or Auberge de montagne des Chic-Chocs.
